bias.en: Downtrend · oversold, broke the $162.9 Jul 29 low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 超卖，跌破 7月29日低点 $162.9

read.en: Marvell fell 7.1% on Nov 4 to $159.80, trading between $154.78 and $166.29 on heavy volume, down 36.5% in five sessions. It is below the falling 5-day ($183.6), 10-day ($209.9), 30-day ($243.5) and 100-day ($235.3) and the rising 200-day ($184.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($239.86), and RSI is 27, oversold.
read.zh: 迈威尔 11月4日下跌 7.1%，收于 $159.80，盘中区间 $154.78–166.29，成交量放大，五个交易日累计下跌 36.5%。股价位于下行的 5 日（$183.6）、10 日（$209.9）、30 日（$243.5）和 100 日均线（$235.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$184.5）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$239.86），RSI 为 27，处于超卖。

read.en: The close broke the $167.4–168.5 support (Nov 2–3 lows) and the $162.9 Jul 29 low; the intraday low of $154.78 undercut the $158 May 12 low before the close recovered above it. Resistance is $162.9–168.5, then $177.3–178 and $183.6–184.5 (5-day, 200-day). Support is $154.8–158, then $146.9 (Apr 28 low). A close above $168.5 would target $178; below $154.8, $147.
